metadata.scope: Focused evidence strengthening across Apt1/2/3/36/37/38/39 and standard 3R/5R feature evidence.
metadata.objective: Convert context/broadened evidence into direct, attributable, normalized evidence where sources support it; preserve unresolved gaps.

methodology_guards: No new valuation or price recommendation.
Built/internal, advertised, balcony, garden, roof and terrace areas are kept separate.
A same-address listing is not an exact sold-unit link by itself.
Tax-derived mirrors are not independent from the direct registered-transaction lane.
Project starting price is not an exact special-unit price.
